easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Don & Leo's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Don & Leo's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.
